summary: No potable water for cooling below the 10,000 CCF large-quantity water user threshold; 50 percent of landscape water from on-site harvesting; 2:1 off-site sensitive-land protection at Council discretion.
notes: A Schubert floor amendment directs staff to keep researching a legal pathway to a ban, with one- and two-year reviews. Prop 207 is cited in coverage as the reason a ban stayed off the table.
confidence_note: Figures are from the May 28 2026 proposal fact sheet. The adopted ordinance (O12268) PDF is a scan with no text layer and has not been read; the adopted page describes 'enhanced separation distances' without figures. Confirm against the adopted text after OCR.
